title: 第二十二章锦衣卫办案六第二十三章六扇门在蠢蠢行动一
content_zh:
讲学内容，从《论语》中的仁政思想，到《史记》中的治国典故，他总能用生动易懂的语言，将深奥的道理讲给太子听。太子不仅学得认真，还常常提出自己的见解，有时甚至会追问一些关于朝堂局势的问题，萧琰也会根据自己的理解，谨慎地为太子解答。
这日，萧琰像往常一样在东宫为太子讲学，讲到“君使臣以礼，臣事君以忠”时，太子突然皱起眉头，小声问道：“萧先生，若是朝中有人不忠于陛下，暗中做坏事，该怎么办呢？”
萧琰心中一怔，太子年纪尚小，却会问出这样的问题，想必是听到了什么风声。他斟酌着回答：“殿下，朝中虽有少数不臣之人，但陛下英明，还有许多像沈佥事那样正直的官员，会辅佐陛下铲除奸邪，维护朝堂清明。殿下只需用心学习，将来才能成为一位明辨是非、体恤百姓的君主。”
太子似懂非懂地点点头，刚想再说些什么，东宫的太监突然匆匆进来禀报：“殿下，萧先生，出事了！御花园的锦鲤池里，发现了一具尸体！”
萧琰和太子都惊呆了。御花园是皇宫禁地，竟然会出现尸体，这可不是小事。太子年纪小，脸色瞬间变得苍白，紧紧抓住了萧琰的衣袖。
萧琰定了定神，对太监说：“此事重大，你立刻去禀报陛下和锦衣卫，我先带着殿下回寝殿，确保殿下安全。”他知道，御花园出现尸体，必然会引起朝堂震动，锦衣卫很快就会介入调查，自己作为太子的伴读，首要任务是保护太子的安全。
安顿好太子后，萧琰心中始终不安。御花园是皇宫核心区域，守卫森严，怎么会有人在此遇害？而且尸体出现在锦鲤池，凶手是故意为之，还是另有隐情？他隐隐觉得，这起案件恐怕不简单，或许还牵扯到宫廷内部的纷争。
果然，没过多久，沈炼就派人来通知萧琰，陛下下令让他协助锦衣卫调查此案。萧琰收拾了一下，立刻前往御花园。
御花园的锦鲤池周围已经围满了锦衣卫，沈炼正站在池边，眉头紧锁地查看现场。看到萧琰过来，沈炼连忙招手：“萧侍读，你来了。你看，尸体是今早被园丁发现的，漂浮在锦鲤池中央，已经派人打捞上来了。”
萧琰走到尸体旁，仔细观察。死者是一名年轻男子，穿着宫中太监的服饰，面色发青，嘴唇发紫，看起来像是中毒身亡。他的手中紧紧攥着一块破碎的玉佩，玉佩的材质和样式，看起来十分名贵，不像是普通太监能拥有的。
“死者身份确认了吗？”萧琰问道。
沈炼点头：“已经确认了，他是东宫的太监小李子，负责照顾太子的起居，平时也会帮太子打理御花园里的几株盆栽。根据园丁所说，昨天傍晚还看到他在锦鲤池附近浇水，之后就没人再见过他，想必是昨晚遇害的。”
萧琰心中一惊：“小李子是东宫的人？那他会不会是因为知道了什么秘密，才被人灭口的？”
“有这个可能。”沈炼说，“我们已经检查过他的住处，没有发现异常，但在他的枕头下，找到了一张纸条，上面写着‘子时，锦鲤池见’，没有署名。看来他是被人约到锦鲤池，然后遇害的。”
萧琰接过纸条，仔细看了看。纸条上的字迹娟秀，像是女子的笔迹。“会不会是宫中的宫女约他见面？或者是有人故意模仿女子的笔迹，引他出来？”
沈炼点头：“我们也在考虑这个可能性。宫中的宫女、太监众多，想要查清是谁约他，并不容易。而且御花园昨晚的守卫记录显示，没有外人进入，凶手很可能就在宫中。”
萧琰环顾四周，锦鲤池位于御花园的偏僻角落，周围有茂密的树木和假山，很容易隐藏。“凶手选择在这里行凶，就是看中了这里偏僻，不易被人发现。小李子手中的玉佩，说不定是凶手留下的，或者是他在挣扎时从凶手身上扯下来的。我们可以从这块玉佩入手，调查它的主人。”
沈炼赞同道：“我已经让人去调查玉佩的来源了。另外，我们还需要询问东宫的其他太监、宫女，了解小李子最近有没有异常举动，或者和什么人有过争执。”
接下来的几天，萧琰和沈炼分头行动。萧琰负责询问东宫的太监、宫女，沈炼则负责调查玉佩的来源和宫中人员的行踪。
通过询问，萧琰了解到，小李子性格开朗，在东宫的人缘很好，最近也没有和人发生过争执。但有宫女提到，最近几天，小李子总是神神秘秘的，经常独自外出，还会偷偷看一些书信，看完后就立刻烧掉。

“他看的书信是什么样子的？你有没有见过？”萧琰连忙问道。
宫女回忆道：“我只见过一次，信纸是淡粉色的，上面还印着梅花图案，看起来很精致，不像是宫中普通的信纸。而且小李子看信的时候，脸上还会泛红，像是在谈恋爱。”
萧琰心中一动，淡粉色印着梅花图案的信纸，很可能是宫中嫔妃或公主使用的。难道小李子和宫中某位女性有私情，因为感情纠纷被灭口？还是说，他是因为知道了这位女性的某个秘密，才被杀人灭口？
与此同时，沈炼也查到了玉佩的来源。这块玉佩是去年陛下赏赐给淑妃的，淑妃十分喜爱，经常佩戴在身上。但最近几天，淑妃却对外宣称玉佩丢失了，还让人在宫中寻找过。
“淑妃？”萧琰听到这个消息，十分惊讶，“淑妃是陛下的宠妃，怎么会和小李子有牵扯？而且她的玉佩，怎么会出现在小李子手中？”
沈炼皱起眉头：“这确实很可疑。淑妃身处后宫，小李子是东宫的太监，按理说他们不应该有过多的交集。或许，小李子知道了淑妃的某个秘密，淑妃为了掩盖秘密，才派人杀了他，还故意把玉佩留在他手中，嫁祸给别人？”
“有这个可能。”萧琰说，“但我们没有证据，不能轻易怀疑淑妃。而且淑妃深受陛下宠爱，若是没有确凿的证据，我们不仅查不出真相，还可能惹祸上身。”
沈炼点头：“你说得对。我们需要进一步调查，找到淑妃和小李子有交集的证据，以及淑妃有杀人动机的证据。”
为了查清淑妃和小李子的关系，萧琰和沈炼决定从淑妃的宫中入手。他们通过锦衣卫在后宫的眼线，了解到淑妃最近的行踪十分诡异，经常在深夜派人出宫，而且还和她的弟弟，户部侍郎李嵩频繁联系。
“李嵩？”萧琰想起，李嵩是淑妃的亲弟弟，在户部任职，之前周显案中，李嵩曾试图为周显说情，被陛下训斥过。“难道淑妃和李嵩在密谋什么？小李子发现了他们的密谋，才被灭口？”
沈炼说：“很有可能。我们可以先调查李嵩最近的行踪，看看他有没有和小李子有过接触，或者有没有在案发当晚出现在御花园附近。”
很快，调查结果就出来了。案发当晚，李嵩以探望淑妃为由，进入了皇宫，而且在深夜时分，有人看到他的随从在御花园附近徘徊。
“这就对了！”沈炼兴奋地说，“李嵩很可能就是凶手，或者是他派随从杀了小李子。淑妃的玉佩，很可能是淑妃故意交给李嵩，让他留在小李子手中，混淆视听，让人以为是后宫争宠引发的命案，从而掩盖他们的密谋。”
萧琰却有些犹豫：“但我们还是没有直接证据。李嵩探望淑妃是合理的，他的随从在御花园附近徘徊，也可能只是偶然。我们需要找到更直接的证据，证明李嵩和小李子的死有关。”
就在这时，锦衣卫在小李子烧毁书信的地方，找到了一些未完全烧毁的纸渣。通过技术手段，他们还原了部分字迹，上面写着“粮草”“边关”“勾结”等字样。
“粮草？边关？”萧琰和沈炼都惊呆了，“难道淑妃和李嵩在勾结边关将领，私运粮草？小李子发现了这个秘密，才被他们灭口？”
这个猜测让两人都感到十分震惊。若是真的，这就是通敌叛国的大罪，不仅淑妃和李嵩会被处死，还可能引发边关动荡，影响朝廷安危。
“我们必须尽快查清此事！”沈炼严肃地说，“萧侍读，你继续在东宫和后宫调查，看看能不能找到更多关于他们私运粮草的证据。我立刻派人去边关调查，看看有没有将领和李嵩有勾结，以及有没有异常的粮草运输记录。”
content_en:
The content of his lectures ranged from the thoughts on benevolent government in The Analects to the allusions about governing the country in "Historical Records". He could always use vivid and easy-to-understand language to explain profound truths to the prince. The prince not only studied seriously, but also often put forward his own opinions, and sometimes even asked some questions about the situation in the court. Xiao Yan would also carefully answer the prince's questions based on his own understanding.
On this day, Xiao Yan was lecturing the prince in the East Palace as usual. When he talked about "the king entrusts his ministers with courtesy, and the ministers serve the king with loyalty", the prince suddenly frowned and asked in a low voice: "Mr. Xiao, what should we do if someone in the court is disloyal to your majesty and does bad things secretly?"
Xiao Yan was startled. The prince was still young, but he would ask such a question. He must have heard some rumors. He replied thoughtfully: "Your Highness, although there are a few disobedient people in the court, your Majesty is wise, and there are many upright officials like Shen Qianshi who will assist your majesty in eradicating evil and maintaining the purity of the court. Your highness only needs to study hard to become a monarch who can distinguish right from wrong and be considerate of the people in the future."
The prince nodded as if he understood. Just when he was about to say something else, the eunuch from the East Palace suddenly came in and reported: "Your Highness, Mr. Xiao, something happened! A corpse was found in the koi pond in the imperial garden!"
Xiao Yan and the prince were both shocked. The Imperial Garden is a forbidden area of ​​the palace, so a corpse would appear. This is no small matter. The prince was young, his face instantly turned pale, and he tightly grasped Xiao Yan's sleeve.
Xiao Yan calmed down and said to the eunuch: "This matter is important. You should report it to His Majesty and the Jin Yiwei immediately. I will take His Highness back to the palace first to ensure His Highness's safety." He knew that the presence of a corpse in the imperial garden would inevitably cause a shock in the court, and the Jin Yiwei would soon intervene in the investigation. As the prince's companion, his first task was to protect the prince's safety.
After settling the prince, Xiao Yan was still uneasy. The Royal Garden is the core area of ​​the palace and is heavily guarded. How could someone be killed here? Moreover, the body appeared in the koi pond. Did the murderer do it on purpose, or did he have another hidden agenda? He had a vague feeling that this case might not be simple, and might involve disputes within the palace.
Sure enough, it didn't take long before Shen Lian sent someone to inform Xiao Yan that His Majesty ordered him to assist Jin Yiwei in investigating the case. Xiao Yan tidied up and immediately went to the Royal Garden.
The koi pond in the Royal Garden was surrounded by Jinyi guards. Shen Lian was standing by the pond, frowning as he inspected the scene. Seeing Xiao Yan coming, Shen Lian hurriedly waved: "Xiao Shidu, you are here. You see, the body was discovered by the gardener this morning. It was floating in the middle of the koi pond. Someone has been sent to salvage it."
Xiao Yan walked to the body and observed it carefully. The deceased was a young man, wearing the clothes of a palace eunuch. His face was blue and his lips were purple. He looked like he had been poisoned. He was holding a broken jade pendant tightly in his hand. The material and style of the jade pendant looked very precious and not something that ordinary eunuchs could own.
"Has the identity of the deceased been confirmed?" Xiao Yan asked.
Shen Lian nodded: "It has been confirmed. He is Xiao Lizi, the eunuch of the East Palace. He is responsible for taking care of the prince's daily life. He also helps the prince take care of several potted plants in the imperial garden. According to the gardener, he was seen watering near the koi pond last evening, and no one has seen him since. He must have been killed last night."
Xiao Yan was shocked: "Xiao Lizi is from the East Palace? Then was he silenced because he knew some secret?"
"It is possible." Shen Lian said, "We have checked his residence and found nothing unusual, but under his pillow, we found a note that said, 'Meet you at the koi pond at midnight' without a signature. It seems that he was invited to the koi pond and then killed."
Xiao Yan took the note and looked at it carefully. The handwriting on the note was beautiful, like a woman's handwriting. "Could it be that a maid in the palace asked him to meet? Or was someone deliberately imitating a woman?Handwriting, lure him out? "
Shen Lian nodded: "We are also considering this possibility. There were many maids and eunuchs in the palace, so it was not easy to find out who was dating him. Moreover, the guard records of the Royal Garden last night showed that no outsiders entered, and the murderer was probably in the palace. "
Xiao Yan looked around. The koi pond was located in a remote corner of the imperial garden. It was surrounded by dense trees and rockeries, making it easy to hide. “The murderer chose to commit his murder here because it was remote and difficult to be discovered. The jade pendant in Xiao Lizi's hand might have been left by the murderer, or he might have torn it off from the murderer during his struggle. We can start with this jade pendant and investigate its owner. "
Shen Lian agreed: "I have already asked people to investigate the source of the jade pendant. In addition, we also need to ask other eunuchs and maids in the East Palace to find out whether Xiao Lizi has behaved unusually recently or had any disputes with anyone. "
In the next few days, Xiao Yan and Shen Lian acted separately. Xiao Yan was responsible for questioning the eunuchs and maids in the East Palace, while Shen Lian was responsible for investigating the source of the jade pendant and the whereabouts of the palace personnel.
Through inquiries, Xiao Yan learned that Xiao Lizi had a cheerful personality, was very popular in the East Palace, and had not had any disputes with anyone recently. But a palace maid mentioned that in recent days, Xiao Lizi has always been mysterious, often going out alone, and secretly reading some letters and burning them immediately after reading them.
"What did the letters he read look like? Have you ever seen it? "Xiao Yan asked quickly.
The palace maid recalled: "I have only seen it once. The letter paper is light pink with plum blossom patterns printed on it. It looks very delicate and does not look like ordinary letter paper in the palace. And when Xiao Lizi read the letter, his face would turn red, as if he was in love. "
Xiao Yan's heart moved. The pale pink stationery with plum blossom patterns was probably used by concubines or princesses in the palace. Could it be that Xiao Lizi had an affair with a certain woman in the palace and was silenced because of a relationship dispute? Or was he killed because he knew some of this woman's secrets?
At the same time, Shen Lian also found out the source of the jade pendant. This jade pendant was given to Concubine Shu by His Majesty last year. Concubine Shu liked it very much and often wore it on her body. But in recent days, Concubine Shu has announced that the jade pendant has been lost, and she even asked people to search for it in the palace.
"Concubine Shu? Xiao Yan was very surprised when he heard the news, "Concubine Shu is His Majesty's favorite concubine, how could she be involved with Xiao Lizi?" And how could her jade pendant appear in Xiao Lizi's hands? "
Shen Lian frowned: "This is indeed suspicious. Concubine Shu is in the harem, and Xiao Lizi is the eunuch of the East Palace. Logically speaking, they should not have too much interaction. Perhaps Xiao Lizi knew a certain secret of Concubine Shu. In order to cover up the secret, Concubine Shu sent someone to kill him and deliberately left the jade pendant in his hands to blame others? "
"It's possible. "Xiao Yan said, "But we have no evidence and cannot easily doubt Concubine Shu. Moreover, Concubine Shu is deeply favored by His Majesty. If there is no conclusive evidence, not only will we not be able to find out the truth, but we may also get into trouble. "
Shen Lian nodded: "You are right. We need to further investigate and find evidence that Concubine Shu and Xiao Lizi have an intersection, and that Concubine Shu has a motive for murder. "
In order to find out the relationship between Concubine Shu and Xiao Lizi, Xiao Yan and Shen Lian decided to start from Concubine Shu's palace. Through Jin Yiwei's spies in the harem, they learned that Concubine Shu's recent whereabouts were very strange. She often sent people out of the palace late at night, and was in frequent contact with her brother, Li Song, the Minister of Household Affairs.
"Li Song? "Xiao Yan remembered that Li Song was Concubine Shu's biological brother and served in the Ministry of Household Affairs. In the previous case of Zhou Xian, Li Song had tried to intercede for Zhou Xian and was reprimanded by His Majesty. "Could Concubine Shu and Li Song be conspiring? Xiao Lizi discovered their conspiracy and was silenced? "
Shen Lian said: "It's very possible. We can first investigate Li Song's recent whereabouts to see if he has had contact with Xiao Lizi, orDid the suspect appear near the Royal Garden on the night of the incident? "
Soon, the results of the investigation came out. On the night of the incident, Li Song entered the palace on the pretext of visiting Concubine Shu, and late at night, his entourage was seen wandering near the Imperial Garden.
"That's right! Shen Lian said excitedly, "Li Song is probably the murderer, or he sent his followers to kill Xiao Lizi." Concubine Shu's jade pendant was most likely given to Li Song on purpose by Concubine Shu, leaving him in Xiao Lizi's hands to confuse people and make people think it was a murder caused by competition for favor in the harem, thereby covering up their conspiracy. "
Xiao Yan hesitated: "But we still have no direct evidence. It is reasonable for Li Song to visit Concubine Shu, and it may be just accidental that his entourage wandered around the imperial garden. We need to find more direct evidence that Li Song is related to Xiao Lizi's death. "
At this moment, Jin Yiwei found some incompletely burned paper scraps where Xiao Lizi burned the letters. Through technical means, they restored part of the handwriting, which said the words "grain and grass", "border pass" and "collusion".
"Food? Border? Xiao Yan and Shen Lian were both shocked, "Could it be that Concubine Shu and Li Song were colluding with the border generals to smuggle grain and grass?" Did they silence Xiao Lizi after they discovered this secret? "
This speculation shocked both of them. If true, this is a serious crime of collaborating with the enemy and treason. Not only will Concubine Shu and Li Song be executed, it may also cause turmoil at the border and affect the safety of the imperial court.
“We must find out about this as soon as possible! Shen Lian said seriously, "Xiao Shidu, you continue to investigate in the East Palace and the Harem to see if you can find more evidence about their smuggling of grain and grass." I immediately sent people to the border to investigate to see if any generals had colluded with Li Song, and if there were any abnormal grain and grass transportation records. "
